arxiv-2305-15976.title: Data-driven Quantum Dynamical Embedding Method for Long-term Prediction on Near-term Quantum Computers
arxiv-2305-15976.creator: Tai-Ping Sun, Zhao-Yun Chen, Cheng Xue, Huan-Yu Liu, Xi-Ning Zhuang, Yun-Jie Wang, Shi-Xin Ma, Hai-Feng Zhang, Yu-Chun Wu, Guo-Ping Guo
arxiv-2305-15976.description: Abstract The increasing focus on long-term time series prediction across various fields has been significantly strengthened by advancements in quantum computation. In this paper, we introduce a data-driven method designed for long-term time series prediction with quantum dynamical embedding (QDE).

arxiv-2308-09055.title: Don’t lose the message while paraphrasing: A study on content preserving style transfer
arxiv-2308-09055.creator: Nikolay Babakov, David Dale, Ilya Gusev, Irina Krotova, Alexander Panchenko
arxiv-2308-09055.description: Abstract Text style transfer techniques are gaining popularity in natural language processing allowing paraphrasing text in the required form: from toxic to neural, from formal to informal, from old to the modern English language, etc. Solving the task is not sufficient to generate some neural/informal/modern text, but it is important to preserve the original content unchanged.

arxiv-2410-21390.title: Bow Shock and Local Bubble Plasma Unveiled by the Scintillating Millisecond Pulsar J0437 − - 4715
arxiv-2410-21390.creator: Daniel J. Reardon 1,2, Robert Main 3,4,5, Stella Koch Ocker 6,7, Ryan M. Shannon 1,2, Matthew Bailes 1,2, Fernando Camilo 8, Marisa Geyer 9,8, Andrew Jameson 1, Michael Kramer 3, Aditya Parthasarathy 10,11,3, Renée Spiewak 1, Willem van Straten 12, Vivek Venkatraman Krishnan 3
arxiv-2410-21390.description: Abstract The ionized interstellar medium contains au-scale (and below) structures that scatter radio waves from pulsars, resulting in scintillation. Power spectral analysis of scintillation often shows parabolic arcs, with curvatures that encode the locations and kinematics of the pulsar, Earth, and interstellar plasma.

arxiv-2503-02969.title: InfiniSST: Simultaneous Translation of Unbounded Speech with Large Language Model
arxiv-2503-02969.creator: Siqi Ouyang, Xi Xu, Lei Li
arxiv-2503-02969.description: Abstract Simultaneous translation of unbounded streaming speech remains a challenging problem due to the need for effectively processing the historical speech context and past translations so that quality and latency, including computation overhead, can be balanced. Most prior works assume pre-segmented speech, limiting their real-world applicability.

arxiv-2506-17180.title: Clear-3K : Assessing Causal Explanatory Capabilities in Language Models
arxiv-2506-17180.creator: Naiming Liu, Richard Baraniuk, Shashank Sonkar
arxiv-2506-17180.description: Abstract We introduce Clear-3K , a dataset of 3,000 assertion-reasoning questions designed to evaluate whether language models can determine if one statement causally explains another. Each question present an assertion-reason pair and challenge language models to distinguish between semantic relatedness and genuine causal explanatory relationships. Through comprehensive evaluation of 21 state-of-the-art language models (ranging from 0.

arxiv-2507-23520.title: Linear quotients, linear resolutions and the lcm-lattice
arxiv-2507-23520.creator: Roni Varshavsky
arxiv-2507-23520.description: Abstract Linear resolutions and the stronger notion of linear quotients are important properties of monomial ideals. In this paper, we fully characterize linear quotients in terms of the lcm-lattice of monomial ideals. We also formulate an analogous characterization for monomial ideals with linear resolutions, making explicit a relationship that is implicit in the existing literature.

arxiv-2512-14731.title: Semantic Geometry for Policy-Constrained Interpretation
arxiv-2512-14731.creator: Nikit Phadke
arxiv-2512-14731.description: Abstract We present a geometric framework for policy-constrained semantic interpretation that provably prevents hallucinated commitments in high-stakes domains. Semantic meaning is represented as direction on a unit sphere, evidence is modeled as sets of witness vectors, and admissible interpretations correspond to spherical convex regions. Policy constraints are introduced as explicit priors defined over the same manifold, separated from evidence geometry.

Data from 130 North Korean refugee mothers were collected between January and March 2023.ResultsThe mean scores were 14.

pmc-11321212.title: The genus Cortinarius should not (yet) be split
pmc-11321212.creator: Brigida Gallone, Thomas W Kuyper, Jorinde Nuytinck
pmc-11321212.description: The genus Cortinarius (Agaricales, Basidiomycota) is one of the most species-rich fungal genera, with thousands of species reported. Cortinarius species are important ectomycorrhizal fungi and form associations with many vascular plants globally. Until recently Cortinarius was the single genus of the family Cortinariaceae, despite several attempts to provide a workable, lower-rank hierarchical structure based on subgenera and sections.

However, the role of DNA methylation in regulating the organ-specific functions of the invasive weed Mikania micrantha remains unknown.ResultsHere, we generated DNA methylation profiles for M.

pmc-11789683.title: Cell-type deconvolution for bulk RNA-seq data using single-cell reference: a comparative analysis and recommendation guideline
pmc-11789683.creator: Xintian Xu, Rui Li, Ouyang Mo, Kai Liu, Justin Li, Pei Hao
pmc-11789683.description: The accurate estimation of cell type proportions in tissues is crucial for various downstream analyses. With the increasing availability of single-cell sequencing data, numerous deconvolution methods that use single-cell RNA sequencing data as a reference have been developed. However, a unified understanding of how these deconvolution approaches perform in practical applications is still lacking.

pmc-12372840.title: Bevacizumab Efficacy and Tolerability in Patients with Metastatic Platinum-Sensitive Ovarian Cancer Beyond Progression
pmc-12372840.creator: Mert Erciyestepe, Şermin Dinç Sonuşen, Şaban Seçmeler, Okan Aydın, Ahmet Emin Öztürk, Aslı Büyükkuşcu, Sezgi Güllü Erciyestepe, Emir Çelik, Kayhan Erturk, Muhammed Mustafa Atcı
pmc-12372840.description: IntroductionHigh recurrence rates and the emergence of resistance mechanisms in ovarian cancer necessitate exploring alternative therapeutic strategies except platinum-based chemotherapies. This has led to the development of bevacizumab, a recombinant humanized monoclonal antibody targeting VEGF. Nevertheless, the continuation of bevacizumab treatment initiated alongside chemotherapy, especially after disease progression, remains a topic of debate.

pmc-12423195.title: Simple scoring model for predicting overt hepatic encephalopathy in geriatric cirrhosis: A multicenter retrospective cohort study
pmc-12423195.creator: Yuki Utakata, Takao Miwa, Masashi Aiba, Shinji Unome, Tatsunori Hanai, Kenji Imai, Yohei Shirakami, Koji Takai, Makoto Shiraki, Naoki Katsumura, Masahito Shimizu
pmc-12423195.description: Identifying the risk of overt hepatic encephalopathy (OHE) in geriatric patients with cirrhosis remains challenging. This study aimed to investigate the independent factors for OHE development in geriatric cirrhosis and to establish a simple scoring model to identify individuals at risk for OHE.

pmc-12610182.title: Ultrasound Evaluation of the Regenerating Tendon of the Semitendinosus After Harvest for Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction
pmc-12610182.creator: Marco Becciolini, Michele Bisogni, Salvatore Massimo Stella, Carlo Trompetto, Laura Mori, Luca Puce, William Campanella, Orlando Catalano, Filippo Cotellessa, Jean François Deux
pmc-12610182.description: Objectives: Previous studies have suggested the potential for semitendinosus (ST) tendon regeneration following harvesting for anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction. This retrospective cross-sectional (observational) study aims to evaluate ST tendon regeneration using high-resolution ultrasound (US), with special reference to morphological and structural changes in the muscle–tendon unit.

pmc-12663276.title: RING1B-BMI1 catalyzed dynamic H2AK119ub1 modification in response to sonic hedgehog signalling during pancreatic differentiation of human embryonic stem cells
pmc-12663276.creator: Niloufer P. Dumasia, Prasad S. Pethe
pmc-12663276.description: Human embryonic stem cells (ESCs) can differentiate into the pancreatic lineage and thus can serve as in vitro models for normal pancreas development. Epigenetic modulators such as RING1B and BMI1, are essential lineage regulators of the pancreatic lineage. Inhibition of the sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway is critical for development of the pancreatic lineage.

pmc-13022809.title: Hot Carrier Injection-Driven Nano-Interface Assembly for Hydrogen Generation
pmc-13022809.creator: Jia-Zhen Zheng, Amit Kumar Sharma, Yen-Hsun Su
pmc-13022809.description: Harnessing hot electron transfer (HET) at plasmonic–semiconductor interfaces is a promising route to modulate charge carrier dynamics toward solar energy-driven water splitting for hydrogen generation. Popular semiconductor photocatalysts driving solar-to-hydrogen conversion, such as FeVO4, suffer from limited visible light absorption, electron–hole recombination, and aqueous instability, often seeking band-gap engineering or cation doping to improve their catalytic prowess.

pmc-13192085.title: Enhancing health outcomes through genetic-based personalized nutrition: investigating the effects of dietary behavior change
pmc-13192085.creator: Hector Guillen-Ahlers, Rajni Nigam, Hannah Pekarek, Kelly Van Gorden, Frankie O’Brien, Kristin Ricklefs-Johnson, Jignesh M. Patel, Yi Zhang
pmc-13192085.description: BackgroundPersonalized nutrition, an approach using individual-specific information to tailor dietary recommendations, has emerged as a promising strategy for promoting healthier eating behaviors and improving health outcomes. This study aimed to assess the impact of genetically informed dietary behavior changes on health improvement.

pmc-13204205.title: Limonoid 7-Deacetoxy-7-oxogedunin (CG-1) Attenuates RANKL-Induced Osteoclastogenesis via Inhibiting PI3K/Akt-NFATc1 Axis
pmc-13204205.creator: Atsushi Koike, Ko Fujimori
pmc-13204205.description: Highlights What are the main findings? CG-1 attenuates RANKL-induced activation of the PI3K/Akt–NFATc1 axis.CG-1 interferes with an early osteoclastogenic signaling cascade. What are the implications of the main findings? CG-1-inhibited RANKL-induced osteoclastogenesis.CG-1 has the potential to inhibit the progression of osteoclast-related bone diseases. AbstractExcessive bone resorption by osteoclasts causes pathological bone loss in diseases such as osteoporosis.

pmc-13331970.title: The association of estimated citrate load with frozen plasma versus four-factor prothrombin complex concentrate for coagulopathy after cardiac surgery: a post hoc exploratory analysis of the FARES-II randomised controlled trial
pmc-13331970.creator: Kenichi A Tanaka, Amir L Butt, Kenneth E Stewart, Gita Pezeshki, Sylvia Werner, Justyna Bartoszko, Kamrouz Ghadimi, Cristina Solomon, Kofi Vandyck, Jerrold H Levy, Jeannie L Callum, Sigurd Knaub, Oliver Hegener, Keyvan Karkouti
pmc-13331970.description: BackgroundFrozen plasma (FP) is the standard haemostatic therapy after cardiopulmonary bypass, but recent trials indicate that FP is inferior to four-factor prothrombin complex concentrate (PCC). Citrate content may contribute to this difference. We compared estimated citrate exposure between patients receiving FP and those receiving PCC and explored its association with postoperative bleeding.
